name: Aternos
limits: Server stops when empty and may queue at peak times. RAM is shared and varies by software/version (about 2.4GB for Vanilla 1.20.1); storage is capped at 4GB.
notes: Free forever and ad-funded. Supports Java/Bedrock, plugins, mods, modpacks and Google Drive backups; no FTP or custom JAR uploads.

name: Minehut
limits: 1GB RAM, 10 player slots and 10GB storage. Free servers sleep when empty; only the paid Ultimate plan stays online 24/7.
notes: No credit card. Java and Bedrock crossplay on one address; plugins install from the web dashboard.

name: FalixNodes
limits: 3GB shared RAM, 1 CPU core, 10GB NVMe and unlimited slots. Stops 10 minutes after the last player leaves; activity check every 3 hours; brief queues when busy.
notes: No card; one server per account. Supports plugins, mods, modpacks, Java/Bedrock and Google Drive backups.

name: FreeMcServer.net
limits: 1.7GB RAM standard, up to 4GB with ads; 10GB NVMe and unlimited slots. Renew every 4 hours (6 with an ad); the server stops 30 minutes after renewal if nobody joins and is deleted after 30 days without renewal.
notes: No card. Full FTP and custom JAR after account verification; extra servers with verification or a Discord boost.

name: Minefort
limits: 1GB RAM and up to 3 free servers. Must be woken manually from the dashboard; locked after 3 days idle and unlocked through staff.
notes: No card. Plugin manager, file manager, FTP and a Bedrock toggle are included.

name: PowerupStack
limits: 3GB total RAM, 2 CPU threads, 4GB SSD and about 10 players recommended. Stops 5 minutes after empty and auto-starts when a player joins; verified accounts keep data about 2 months.
notes: No card. Java/Bedrock support, approved plugins only, no hard player-slot cap.

name: SwiftServers
limits: 2GB RAM, 1.25 CPU cores and 10GB NVMe. Sleeps 5 minutes after empty and wakes when a player joins; hibernated after 7 days offline and deleted after 30 days.
notes: No card and no ads. Java/Bedrock crossplay, plugins/modpacks, backups and a public server hub.

name: FreeGameHost
limits: 4GB RAM, 200% CPU, 6GB NVMe and unlimited slots. Claims true 24/7 with no idle shutdown; resources are self-reported and ad-funded.
notes: No card. Pterodactyl panel, FTP/SFTP and daily backups. Newer, less established provider.

name: Tick Hosting
limits: Free tiers offer 4GB, 6GB or 8GB RAM with 10GB NVMe and unlimited slots. Renew every 8, 6 or 4 hours; the server stays online between renewals but stops if one is missed.
notes: No card. SFTP, modpacks and five regions. 24/7 while renewals are maintained.

name: AxentHost
limits: Choose 2–16GB RAM using free credits (5 credits per GB per hour), up to 20GB NVMe, no slot cap. No idle sleep; the server stops only when the credit balance reaches zero.
notes: No card. Free credits are claimed hourly; Java/Bedrock crossplay, mods/plugins and backups are included.

name: Severoo
limits: Up to 6GB RAM and 15GB NVMe with no player cap. Stays online while renewed with free credits; renewal is every few hours. Suspended if missed and deleted after 7 days.
notes: No card; credits cannot be bought. Supports plugins, mods and Java/Bedrock crossplay.

name: CoalByte
limits: 3GB dedicated RAM, 1 vCPU and 8GB NVMe. Claims 24/7 operation with no idle shutdown; no player cap is stated.
notes: No card. Newer provider with Java/Bedrock crossplay, SFTP and backups. Verify availability before committing a world.

name: HidenCloud
limits: 2.5GB RAM, 1.5 vCPU and 10GB disk on the documented free plan (the service page lists 3GB/15GB). Renew weekly; suspended after 7 days and deleted 5 days later. Ads appear in the panel.
notes: No card; one free service per user. Java/Bedrock/PocketMine, SFTP and weekly renewal. Free slots are often full.

name: OuiHeberg
limits: 8GB RAM, 2 vCores, 2GB SSD and a hard limit of 4 simultaneous players. Monthly activity confirmation is required; mods and modpacks are not allowed.
notes: No card. Servers stay online when empty; plugins are supported and Bedrock joins through Geyser. Best for very small groups.

name: Oracle Cloud Always Free (Self-Setup)
limits: 12GB RAM, 2 ARM cores and 200GB block storage. ARM capacity varies by region; idle instances may be reclaimed after 7 days below 20% usage, and accounts may be suspended after 30 days idle.
notes: Self-hosted: you install Java, open ports and manage backups. Always Free and includes two 1GB AMD micro VMs.
